title: Constant module realization preserves cokernels without flatness
statement: Let (C,J) be a site with independent object and morphism universes, R a commutative ring in their maximum universe, B a commutative ring sheaf, and σ:R_constant→B. Use the constant module sheaf functor [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor], scalar extension [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume weak sheafification for additive groups, rings and commutative rings, compatibility of forgetting commutativity with sheaves, and that the additive sheafification equivalences are precisely locally bijective maps. For every R-module morphism d:M→N there is an isomorphism E_B(coker d)≅coker(E_B(d)) whose composite with E_B of the cokernel projection is the new cokernel projection. No flatness is required.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), finite-presentation calculation; Stacks, algebra.tex lemma-tensor-product-exact; sites-modules.tex section-constant and section-tensor-product.

proof.text: The composite of the constant-module functor and the forgetful functor to additive sheaves preserves finite colimits; additive constant sheafification and the module forgetful functor preserve these colimits. Reflection by the module-sheaf forgetful functor gives preservation by the constant-module functor.
Scalar extension is left adjoint to restriction by the existing explicit generic tensor adjunction. Compose the two finite-colimit-preserving functors.
Use PreservesCokernel.iso and its projection equation.

lean.statement: theorem constantScalarCokernel {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R] [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}] [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}] [HasWeakSheafify J RingCat.{max u v}] [HasWeakSheafify J CommRingCat.{max u v}] (B : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (σ : (constantSheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}).obj (CommRingCat.of R) ⟶ B) {M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} R} (d : M ⟶ N) : ∃ w : extension J R B σ (cokernel d) ≅ cokernel (extensionMap J R B σ d), extensionMap J R B σ (cokernel.π d) ≫ w.hom = cokernel.π (extensionMap J R B σ d)
